text.ru: Крохотный отблеск находит щель в любой броне.

art: a tiny darting dart-sprite creature of red ray-light, a living needle-sharp mote with a sharp glinting tip, slipping through the smallest gap in armor

text.ru: Строй для него — лишь повод разогнаться.

art: a charging ram-beast of white-hot red ray-light, lowered glowing horns leveled to smash straight through a line of defenders toward the foe behind them

text.ru: Заходит не в строй, а мимо строя — прямо к горлу.

art: a spiral drill-beast of red ray-light boring forward in a tight glowing helix, slipping past every defender straight toward the foe behind them

text.ru: Его серп оставляет след, что не затянуть.

art: a gaunt towering reaper of crimson ray-light, a long burning scythe sweeping forward, the wounds it carves glowing and unhealing

text.ru: Затопчи — и он разгорится с новой силой.

art: a roaring bonfire of red light that keeps re-kindling brighter when struck, pulling glowing motes of life from everything it scorches

text.ru: Каждая рана — лишь топливо, и от неё оно горит ярче.

art: a small floating fire-elemental creature shaped like a glowing red forge-crucible brimming with flame, drawing glowing motes of life out of its prey to stoke its own brightening fire

text.ru: Чем глубже впилась, тем ярче горит сама.

art: a fat glowing leech creature, a plump segmented worm-like blood-sucker of red ember-light, its round sucker-mouth latched onto prey, drawing glowing motes of life up through its swollen body and burning brighter inside

text.ru: Жар не разбирает своих и чужих.

art: a radial firestorm of red ray-light scything outward across the whole field in every direction, searing everything it sweeps over

text.ru: Сначала стреляет, потом думает. Если выживет.

art: a wild little fire-imp creature of red flame-light loosing a searing spark-bolt the instant it appears, cinders raining around it

text.ru: Один росчерк луча — и цели как не бывало.

art: a single clean slash of red ray-light cutting across a target, a bright searing arc and a spray of cinders

text.ru: Что урвал в горниле боя — то твоё.

art: a lean carrion-bird of red ray-light wheeling low over a smouldering field, snatching a single glowing card-mote in its beak

text.ru: Один и тот же огонь жжёт и тварь, и наваждение.

art: a gout of red ember-light washing over both a creature and a glowing enchantment-weave at once, searing one and burning the other to ash

text.ru: Первый удар лишь высекает из него искры.

art: a proud golden champion-beast of light, the first strike against it bursting harmlessly into a bright flare of scattering sparks

text.ru: Бей по нему — он только этого и ждёт.

art: a stout armored guardian-beast forged of dense golden light, planted immovably behind a great barricade of radiance, daring every blow to land on it

text.ru: В полдень у вещей не остаётся тени, чтобы спрятаться.

art: a vast ambient blaze of golden noon light flooding the whole field, burning away every shadow and pool of darkness so nothing stays hidden

text.ru: Зажги дозор — и ни одна тень не пройдёт незамеченной.

art: a ring of tall golden signal-fires blazing around the field, their light throwing back every shadow to lay bare what hides, a warm shielding glow over those within

text.ru: Луч обходит поле дозором и хранит своих.

art: a tall lighthouse-beam of golden light sweeping in a slow circle over the whole field, casting back every shadow and wrapping allies in a warm protective glow

text.ru: Когда солнце в зените, прятаться попросту негде.

art: a blazing high sun hanging directly overhead, its flat white-gold glare pouring straight down over the whole field so nothing casts a shadow to hide in

text.ru: Его явление само по себе — долгий приговор зрению.

art: a towering herald-beast wreathed in scorching golden light, its blazing arrival searing the sight of a single foe to white

text.ru: Свет ударил — и весь строй ослеп.

art: a sudden overwhelming blast of pure sun-light slamming across the enemy line, every foe staggering and clutching its seared eyes

text.ru: Его последняя вспышка слепит всё поле разом.

art: a radiant winged herald-being wreathed in collapsing-star light, its whole form flaring into an overwhelming blinding burst across the whole enemy line

text.ru: Подними глаза в зенит — и больше ничего не увидишь.

art: a sudden vertical column of pure white-gold light erupting at the zenith and flooding down over the whole enemy line, every foe blinded white

text.ru: Несёт свет — и вместе с ним добрую весть.

art: a radiant herald-moth of golden dawn-light, broad luminous wings raised over the field, lifting a single glowing card into the light it carries

text.ru: На свету заря не оставляет ни одного наваждения.

art: a pale golden dawn-flare washing across the field, every lingering enchantment-weave of any colour dissolving to nothing in its light

text.ru: Пьёт свет и возвращает его кристаллами.

art: a small radiant bloom-creature of green light, soft petals drinking in light and condensing it into glowing crystal-motes

text.ru: Что ни день — то новый росток и две горсти света.

art: a living mound-creature of rich green light, its dark soil-body sprouting fresh shoots all over and breathing glowing pollen-motes upward

text.ru: Отвернёшься на ход — он уже выше тебя.

art: a restless climbing bindweed of green light, visibly lengthening and thickening as it coils upward, new shoots unfurling

text.ru: Кормится тем, что отжило, и сеет новое горстями.

art: a shelf of bracket-fungus woven from decaying green light, feeding on fallen motes and puffing out drifting clouds of spore-light

text.ru: Из всего, что пало рядом, он растит себя.

art: a squat mulch-mound creature of dark green light, drawing the glow of fallen things into itself and swelling thicker with each one

text.ru: Чем гуще соседи, тем выше крона.

art: a towering walking grove-treant of green light, many trunks fused into one lumbering tree-being, growing taller and broader the more allies crowd around it

text.ru: Один порыв ветра — и взойдёт целое поле.

art: a tiny living pollen-sprite of green light, a small glowing mote-creature trailing spores that take root and sprout wherever it drifts

text.ru: Его корни оплели все твои кристаллы.

art: an immense ancient world-tree of green light, glowing roots threading out into a lattice of crystals, greater for each one it grasps

text.ru: Растёт в лад с каждым твоим кристаллом.

art: a tiny green sapling of light, its thin trunk humming and brightening in tune with a ring of crystals around it, taller for each one

text.ru: Тянется к свету в каждой грани кристалла.

art: a glowing green taproot of light burrowing through a bed of crystals, swelling and branching greater for every facet it touches

text.ru: Что выросло — то и снимешь в руку.

art: a lush green vine creature heavy with a single glowing ripe green fruit, the fruit swelling and lifting free as a glowing green card

text.ru: Оплетёт любые чары и стиснет в труху.

art: an aggressive green strangler-vine of light coiling around and crushing a glowing enchantment-weave, tightening until it crumbles to dust

text.ru: Где она ляжет, там всё движется вполсилы.

art: a slow creeping field of pale blue rime-frost spreading across the ground, glazing everything it touches in numbing cold

text.ru: Здесь стынет всё — и сталь, и кровь, и сама воля.

art: a vast creeping expanse of deep-blue hoarfrost swallowing the whole field, ancient frozen ground glittering with cold pale light, a numbing aura with no figure in it

text.ru: Долгая ночь студит врага до самых костей.

art: a creeping field of deep-blue polar twilight settling over the ground, a dim aura of bone-deep cold with no figure in it, frost dimming everything it reaches

text.ru: Под этим пологом замирает любое движение.

art: a heavy pall of deep-blue winter cold draped over the whole field, a thick numbing aura of glittering frost-haze with no figure in it

text.ru: Время вокруг цели просто остановилось.

art: bands of blue frost-light clamping around a target, locking it motionless inside a casing of pale ice

text.ru: Он смотрит сквозь воду на ход вперёд.

art: an ancient seer-being of deep blue light, slow lenses of foresight orbiting its head as it reads what is yet to come

text.ru: Был на столе — и нет, унесло волной.

art: a cold blue wave of light washing across a creature and pulling it back out to sea, dissolving it into drifting mist

text.ru: Сквозь верную линзу видно на две карты вперёд.

art: a large round polished glass lens held up in the foreground, glowing deep blue, a clear focused beam of light passing through it, two glowing cards sharpening into crisp focus on the far side of the lens

text.ru: Тихая вода и грядущее покажет, и чары смоет.

art: a still pool of clear glowing blue water seen from above, its calm transparent surface mirror-flat, a tangled glowing enchantment-weave sinking into the clear water and dissolving thread by thread in the depths

text.ru: Сегодня вглядись, а завтра поймёшь вдвойне.

art: a slow-turning glass hourglass glowing deep blue, fine blue sand pooling in its lower bulb, two glowing cards rising into focus inside the glass to surface only a turn later

text.ru: Чем глубже вглядишься, тем больше выловишь.

art: a patient deep-blue study-being poring over slow drifting pages of frozen glass, lifting a single fresh page of light free as a card

text.ru: Холодная вода смывает любую морось чар.

art: a cold blue undertow surging across the field and rinsing a glowing enchantment-weave loose, carrying it away dissolved into drifting mist

text.ru: Краем глаза видел — а посмотришь, и нет.

art: a faint violet wisp-creature of refracted light, half-faded from sight, a small drifting sprite slipping along the edge of vision and never quite there

text.ru: Убьёшь его — останется тень убитого.

art: a mournful phantom of violet light, faint and translucent, a fading after-image of itself trailing behind as it drifts

text.ru: Который из трёх настоящий? Ни один.

art: a humanoid silhouette drawn as flat violet light-lines, not a realistic painted person, splitting into two faint mirror-copies of itself, all three shimmering and indistinct

text.ru: У него столько лиц, сколько нужно.

art: a shifting manyfaced silhouette drawn as flat violet light-lines, not a realistic painted person, its outline fracturing into a whole crowd of faint duplicates fanning out around it

text.ru: Он лежал среди твоих кристаллов и ждал.

art: a patient shade of violet light biding among banked crystals, half-dissolved into shadow, quietly waiting to wake

text.ru: Пролежит сколько надо и встанет сам.

art: a dormant violet wraith-figure drawn as flat violet light-lines, not a realistic person and not an animal, sealed upright and motionless asleep inside a banked crystal, near-invisible, biding its time to rouse itself unbidden

text.ru: Разбуди его сам — или дождись, пока встанет.

art: a sly violet lurker-spirit creature folded into a single banked crystal, its faint outline waiting to be woken or to stir on its own

text.ru: Свет согнулся — и вот их уже двое.

art: a ripple of bending violet light conjuring a faint duplicate of a creature beside it, shimmering and unreal

text.ru: Один шагнул в свет — а вышло двое.

art: a corridor of bent violet light-mirrors, a creature stepping through and a second shimmering duplicate of it peeling away alongside

text.ru: Самый незримый луч стирает саму форму.

art: a thin violet ray from the unseen edge of the spectrum striking a target and unweaving it, its form erased into a scatter of fading motes

text.ru: Преломи чары — и они расползутся по нитям.

art: a knot of violet refracted light catching a glowing enchantment-weave and bending it apart thread by thread until it unravels into nothing

text.ru: Незрима — и видит твою колоду насквозь.

art: a half-unseen violet shade peering out from the edge of vision, silently drawing a single glowing card into the dark with it

text.ru: Все пять лучей склонились в одну корону.

art: a crowned sovereign-figure drawn entirely as flat glowing light-lines, not a realistic painted person, a five-pointed crown of light above, all five rays in balance -- red, yellow, green, blue and violet, none dominant -- a still commanding pose and a sharp piercing forward gaze, a faint tide of light sweeping from one outstretched hand, stylized graphic light-line illustration

text.ru: Растёт, пока светит, и троится в зеркалах зари.

art: a living miniature sun blazing in balanced rainbow -- red, yellow, green, blue and violet, none dominant, swelling as it burns behind a bright shield of radiance, its watchful light reaching ahead, a faint mirror-double shimmering beside it

text.ru: Незримый, неотвратимый, и тень его не уйдёт.

art: a hulking six-limbed predator-beast woven of light in balanced rainbow -- red, yellow, green, blue and violet, none dominant, its claws opening wounds that bleed crimson light and never close, haloed in a warding glow, spore-light drifting from its hide, a pale echo trailing it

text.ru: Один свет — и уже не сосчитать, сколько их.

art: a dense roiling cluster of countless distinct sharp glowing light-motes massing together, every colour of the spectrum in balance -- red, yellow, green, blue and violet, none dominant, knitting its wounds shut, puffing spore-light, a swirling living swarm, not a humanoid

text.ru: Все пять лучей, сжатые в один кулак.

art: a colossal many-faceted crystalline colossus, no human face, every ray of the rainbow -- red, yellow, green, blue and violet -- blazing in balance along its towering crystal frame, none dominant, drinking the life from what it strikes, a blinding flare at its crown, biding hidden among crystals

text.ru: Щит впереди, луч насквозь.

art: a charging armored beast of red-and-gold sunset light, lowered glowing horns leveled to pierce, a broad shield of radiance across its chest

text.ru: Стоит на свету и сам себя латает.

art: a huge shelled bastion-beast of red and gold light, a living rampart planted to draw every blow, cracks in its glowing shell knitting shut with warm radiance

text.ru: Чем больше крови, тем выше шипы.

art: a thorned blackthorn of crimson and emerald light, draining life through its barbs and growing taller with every drop it takes

text.ru: Вытопчешь — оно гуще прежнего.

art: a sprawling tangle of hardy red-green weed-light, regrowing where cut and thicker for every other plant beside it

text.ru: Уголёк лёг сейчас, а полыхнёт на следующем ходу.

art: a slow-falling ember of red light settling on a target and smouldering, a deep blue ring of held time around it, poised to flare into a deep unhealing burn a turn later

text.ru: Бьёт насквозь и оставляет во льду.

art: a harpoon-being of red ray-light tipped in blue frost, lunging to pierce a foe and lock it in rime as it lands

text.ru: Не увидишь руки — и рана не затянется.

art: a sleek half-unseen panther-beast of red-violet light, slipping through shadow, an unhealing wound bleeding crimson light trailing from its glowing claws

text.ru: Проскользнёт мимо строя, а погибнув — оставит тень.

art: a swift winged shadow-beast of dim red-violet light gliding past a defending line toward the foe, a faint after-image trailing its wings

text.ru: Стоит стеной и кормит светом.

art: a towering rooted oak-treant of yellow-green light, a single great tree-being planted like a wall, breathing warm mana-motes upward

text.ru: Под золотой коркой — росток, что всё крепнет.

art: a young golden seedling of yellow-green light sheathed in a bright protective rind, growing sturdier by the hour

text.ru: Хмарь сгущается с вечера, а слепнешь поутру.

art: a cold murky bank of yellow-blue haze gathering at the edge of the field, a ring of held blue time within it, swelling to roll over a foe and sear it blind a turn later

text.ru: Встал на пути — и путь застыл.

art: a towering guardian-elemental built of smooth glowing blue ice-light, haloed in golden radiance, its crystalline icy body lit from within, spilling freezing cold to lock the nearest foe in place

text.ru: Свет, которого не видно, пока он не ослепит.

art: an unseen will-o-wisp creature of pale yellow-violet light, invisible until it flares and sears a foe's sight to white

text.ru: Поди пойми, который отблеск настоящий.

art: a sly little wisp-creature of yellow-violet light haloed in protective radiance, splitting off a faint mirror-copy of itself

text.ru: Роняет ростки, а в каплях росы видит, что грядёт.

art: a delicate flower of green light beaded with glowing deep-blue dew, dropping fresh shoots from its petals into the soil while the dewdrops mirror what is yet to come

text.ru: Стелется под снегом и студит всё на пути.

art: a sprawling web of glowing green fungal threads with little mushroom-caps sprouting along it, spreading across the ground and puffing thick clouds of green spore-light, the whole network laced and crusted with pale blue frost, breathing a freezing chill onto the nearest foe

text.ru: Гниль и морок — две стороны распада.

art: a drifting fungal spore-beast of green-violet light, a bloated mushroom-body puffing spore-clouds, a faint spectral echo trailing it

text.ru: Кормится падалью и плодит себя.

art: a rotting many-bodied creature of green-violet light feeding on fallen motes, peeling off a faint duplicate of itself, a writhing mass of decay-light

text.ru: Настоящего смыло — осталась лишь рябь-двойник.

art: a violet-blue mirror-surface of light rippling outward in strong concentric ripples, a creature warping and doubling across the rippling waves, one image washing away while a faint shimmering duplicate rises in its place

text.ru: Не увидишь того, кто утянул тебя в глубину.

art: a half-unseen deep-sea predator-beast of blue and violet light, coiling unseen in the cold dark deep, lunging out to seize a foe and drag it down and away into the depths, violet and blue in equal measure, neither dominant

text.ru: Один луч — и в нём уже все цвета.

art: Iris, a poised duelist-painter, raises a faceted glass prism; a beam of white light enters and arcs out of it as a rainbow fan sweeping across her, her brush trailing refracted color

text.ru: Я пишу не светом, а его отсутствием.

art: Erebus, half-swallowed in shadow, haloed by the bright corona of a total eclipse; darkness drips from his brush as he paints with the absence of light

text.ru: Смешай два света — и родится третий.

art: Tiziana, a painter holding up a large round glowing artist's palette laden with light-paints in one hand, sweeping a broad brush across it with the other as two colours stream together and bloom into a third where they meet

text.ru: Я бужу свет огранённым.

art: Gemma holds a many-faceted crystal up to the light and strikes a clean facet, splitting a thin beam into sharp geometric glints
